Name: Letters from Shane
Author: J4ZMIN
Description:
[center][font=Arial][color=#d074c4][size=5][b][i]Letters from Shane[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[size=3][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/fe/Mail.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=3]This mod adds[b] new mail[/b] and [b]gifts [/b]from Shane at each heart level. As your relationship progresses, his gifts become more meaningful.
[/size]
[b][color=#d074c4][size=4]Features[/size][/color][/b][size=3]
[list]
[*][size=3]Gifts at each heart level.[/size]
[*][size=3]Special letters when dating or engaged to Shane.[/size]
[/list][/size][size=2][i]Also translated to Spanish.
[font=Arial]If you have any suggestions for new gifts, characters or features, please do let me know![/font][/i]
[/size]
[b][color=#d074c4][size=4]How to Install[/size][/color][/b][b][color=#d074c4]
[/color][/b][list=1]
[*][size=3]Download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29763?tab=files]mod file[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract to your "[font=Arial]Mods[/font]" folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]Launch the game via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy![/size]
[/list][color=#d074c4][size=4][b]My other mods[/b][/size][/color][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32091]Letters from Harvey[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30259/]Letters from Sam[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29931]Letters from Sebastian[/url]﻿.[/size]
[/list]
